title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: A.S.E 2.0：理解仓库上下文如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agents construct a repository context before generating code. For security-sensitive code, this context decides whether the model sees the project’s safeguards (e.g., authorization checks) or insecure code to imitate. However, context construction is designed almost exclusively for functional correctness, and secure-code benchmarks treat the context as fixed, so how repository context affects the security of generated code remains unclear. We construct CASE-Bench , a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks from real CVEs in 51 projects. Each task runs in Docker, has functional tests and a proof-of-concept exploit validated in both directions, and is annotated with the repository code that enforces or undermines its security. Using CASE-Bench , we compare 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs, edit single context elements, and analyze coding-agent trajectories. We find that ❶ functionality-oriented context raises the functional pass rate by up to 8.2 percentage points (pp) but the secure pass rate by at most 3.7 pp, ❷ withholding a safeguard lowers the secure pass rate by up to 8.1 pp, while one inserted insecure exemplar raises correct-but-exploitable code by 6.3 pp, and ❸ coding agents observe the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of trajectories. These findings inform security-aware context construction and secure-code evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）编程助手与智能体在生成代码之前会构建仓库上下文。 对于安全敏感的代码，这一上下文决定了模型看到的是项目的安全防护措施（例如授权检查）还是可供模仿的不安全代码。 然而，上下文构建几乎完全是为功能正确性而设计的，而安全代码基准又把上下文视为固定不变的，因此仓库上下文如何影响生成代码的安全性仍不清楚。 我们构建了 CASE-Bench，这是一个包含来自 51 个项目真实 CVE 的 145 个仓库级任务的基准。 每个任务都在 Docker 中运行，具有经过双向验证的功能测试和概念验证（proof-of-concept）漏洞利用，并标注了仓库中实施或破坏其安全性的代码。 利用 CASE-Bench，我们针对六个 LLM 比较了 13 种上下文构建方法与六个对照方法，对单个上下文元素进行修改，并分析了编程智能体的轨迹。 我们发现：❶面向功能的上下文可将功能通过率最多提升 8.2 个百分点（pp），但安全通过率最多仅提升 3.7 个百分点；❷隐去一项安全防护措施会使安全通过率最多下降 8.1 个百分点，而插入一个不安全示例会使“正确但可被利用”的代码增加 6.3 个百分点；❸编程智能体仅在 27–36% 的轨迹中观察到相关的安全防护措施。 这些发现为安全感知的上下文构建和安全代码评估提供了参考。

paragraphs.en: LLM coding assistants and agents rarely generate code from the prompt alone. They first assemble context from the repository (e.g., similar code or imported definitions) ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . For security-sensitive code, the information that makes an implementation safe is often not local: a parser may need the zero-divisor check of a sibling routine, and an endpoint may need a project-specific permission. Context construction therefore decides whether the model sees the repository’s security policy, and it can also expose legacy code with the same weakness (§ 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: LLM 编程助手与智能体很少仅凭提示词就生成代码。 它们首先会从代码仓库中组装上下文（例如相似代码或导入的定义）( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) 。 对于安全敏感的代码而言，使实现安全的信息往往不在本地：一个解析器可能需要同模块中相邻例程的除零检查，一个端点可能需要项目特定的权限。 因此，上下文的构建决定了模型能否看到代码仓库的安全策略，它也可能暴露出存在相同缺陷的遗留代码（§ 2.2 ）。

paragraphs.en: Context construction has nevertheless been designed and evaluated almost exclusively for functional correctness ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Le Hai et al., 2025 ) . Secure-code benchmarks have moved from snippets ( Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ; Bhatt et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) to real repositories ( Lian et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , and RealSec-bench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) observes that retrieval improves correctness more than security. However, existing benchmarks cannot explain how context affects security, because most of them share four limitations. ❶ Context is fixed, not studied. They evaluate one context configuration or compare a few retrievers, so no benchmark explains which context properties cause the gap between correctness and security. ❷ Security oracles are static or untargeted. Many benchmarks judge security with static rules or LLM judges ( Lian et al., 2026 ; Hajipour et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , which miss runtime-dependent weaknesses and cannot show that the specific weakness is exploitable. ❸ Functionality is not validated jointly. Without functional tests, broken or deny-all code can look secure ( Lian et al., 2026 ; Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ) . ❹ Security-relevant context is not measurable. No benchmark records which repository code enforces or undermines security, so outcomes cannot be attributed to the content of a context.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，上下文构建的设计和评估几乎完全以功能正确性为标准（Zhang et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2025b；Gu et al., 2025；Le Hai et al., 2025）。 安全代码基准已从代码片段（Siddiq and Santos, 2022；Bhatt et al., 2023；Peng et al., 2025）发展到真实仓库（Lian et al., 2026；Shen et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026a；Zhao et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026b），并且 RealSec-bench（Wang et al., 2026b）观察到检索对正确性的提升大于对安全性的提升。 然而，现有基准无法解释上下文如何影响安全性，因为它们大多存在四个局限。❶ 上下文是固定的，而非研究对象。 它们只评估一种上下文配置或比较少数几个检索器，因此没有任何基准能解释哪些上下文属性导致了正确性与安全性之间的差距。❷ 安全性判定是静态的或无针对性的。 许多基准使用静态规则或 LLM 判定器来评判安全性（Lian et al., 2026；Hajipour et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2026b），这会遗漏依赖运行时的弱点，且无法证明特定弱点是可被利用的。❸ 功能性未与安全性联合验证。 缺乏功能测试时，损坏的或“全部拒绝”式的代码可能看起来是安全的（Lian et al., 2026；Siddiq and Santos, 2022）。❹ 与安全相关的上下文不可度量。 没有任何基准记录仓库中哪些代码强制执行或破坏了安全性，因此无法将结果归因于上下文的内容。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we construct CASE-Bench , a benchmark of 145 repository-level generation tasks derived from 144 real CVEs in 51 open-source projects. The tasks are diverse , covering 28 CWEs in seven languages, and they span different difficulty levels , from generic checks to project-specific policies. They are also of high quality : every task is reproducible in a Docker environment, and its functional tests and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit are validated against both the vulnerable and the patched version (❷, ❸). Two experts annotated the security-relevant repository code of every task (❹). On CASE-Bench , we hold the task, prompt, and oracle fixed and vary only the context (❶). We compare 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs, edit single context elements, and analyze what coding agents observe. Our study answers the following research questions:

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How do context construction methods affect the correctness and security of generated code? We measure the functional and secure pass rates of real methods against the target file alone and against security controls.

sents.zh: RQ1：上下文构建方法如何影响生成代码的正确性和安全性？

paragraphs.en: We additionally check whether the conclusions depend on the security oracle.

paragraphs.en: Our study shows that functionality-oriented context raises the functional pass rate by up to 8.2 percentage points (pp) but the secure pass rate by at most 3.7 pp, with no significant difference from the target file alone. Context helps when it exposes concrete safeguards: withholding a safeguard lowers the secure pass rate by up to 8.1 pp, whereas a security-themed placebo has almost no effect. It hurts when it exposes insecure exemplars, one of which raises correct-but-exploitable code by 6.3 pp even with the safeguard present. Coding agents share this bias toward functionality, observing the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of their trajectories.

paragraphs.en: We construct CASE-Bench , an executable benchmark whose tasks are validated in both directions, solvable within the edit scope, and annotated with security-relevant repository code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 CASE-Bench，这是一个可执行的基准，其任务经过双向验证、可在编辑范围内解决，并标注了与安全相关的仓库代码。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a controlled study of 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs (49,590 generations), which extends the functionality-security gap reported for a few retrievers to all major method families.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 13 种上下文构建方法和六个对照项在六个 LLM 上进行了受控研究（共 49,590 次生成），这将此前仅针对少数检索器报告的功能性-安全性差距扩展到了所有主要方法家族。

paragraphs.en: Through single-element context edits, failure patterns, and 1,305 agent trajectories, we show which elements change security and derive guidelines for security-aware context construction.
paragraphs.zh: 通过单元素上下文编辑、失败模式以及 1,305 条智能体轨迹，我们展示了哪些元素会改变安全性，并推导出了面向安全感知上下文构建的指导原则。

paragraphs.en: Task and context. A task comprises a repository at the last vulnerable commit, a target file with a removed code region (the masked region ), and a requirement that specifies its functionality. The model must regenerate the masked region and is never told that the task is security-relevant (§ 3.1 ). A context construction method selects repository units (e.g., functions) to accompany the requirement and the masked target file.
paragraphs.zh: 任务与上下文。 一个任务包含处于最后一次存在漏洞的提交时的代码仓库、一个带有被移除代码区域（掩码区域）的目标文件，以及指定其功能的需求。 模型必须重新生成掩码区域，且从不被告知该任务与安全相关（§ 3.1）。 上下文构建方法会选择仓库单元（例如函数）来伴随需求和掩码的目标文件。

paragraphs.en: Outcomes. Each generated implementation is built, tested, and attacked with the task’s exploit, and it receives one of four outcomes: Unbuildable , Incorrect (a functional test fails), correct but exploitable ( CbE : all tests pass, but the exploit succeeds), or Secure (all tests pass, and the exploit shows no effect). Both labels are relative to the task’s oracles: “correct” means passing the provided tests, and a failed exploit does not rule out other vulnerabilities (§ 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 每个生成的实现都会被构建、测试，并使用任务的漏洞利用程序进行攻击，并获得四种结果之一：不可构建、不正确（某个功能测试失败）、正确但可被利用（CbE：所有测试通过，但漏洞利用成功），或安全（所有测试通过，且漏洞利用无效）。 这两个标签都相对于任务的判定标准而定：“正确”指通过提供的测试，而漏洞利用失败并不排除其他漏洞的存在（§ 3.2）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows a task derived from CVE-2021-20205, a divide-by-zero vulnerability in the GIF reader of libjpeg-turbo. The requirement asks for parsing the image dimensions but does not mention that they may be zero, whereas the other image readers of the same repository reject zero dimensions. With four functionality-oriented contexts that lacked such a check, the code of GPT-5.4 passed all tests but was exploited by a zero-width GIF in every run. With the ReACC-Hybrid context, which contained the guard of the Targa reader, the model reproduced the guard and was secure in every run. Similarity retrieval exposed the guard here, but it could equally have retrieved an unchecked sibling; our controlled context edits separate these effects.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了一个源自 CVE-2021-20205 的任务，这是 libjpeg-turbo 的 GIF 读取器中的一个除零漏洞。 该需求要求解析图像尺寸，但没有提到尺寸可能为零，而同一代码库中的其他图像读取器都会拒绝零尺寸。 在四个缺少此类检查的功能导向上下文中，GPT-5.4 生成的代码通过了所有测试，但在每次运行中都被一个零宽度 GIF 利用。 使用包含 Targa 读取器防护逻辑的 ReACC-Hybrid 上下文时，该模型复现了防护逻辑，并在每次运行中都保持安全。 相似度检索在这里暴露了防护逻辑，但它同样可能检索到一个未做检查的同级代码；我们的受控上下文编辑将这两种效应区分开来。

paragraphs.en: As an analysis framework, we relate each context unit to the security policy that the masked region must enforce (e.g., a bounds check or an authorization rule). A unit may serve several roles, and some units remain unclassified. From prior work, we derive four candidate mechanisms, which we treat as hypotheses.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一种分析框架，我们将每个上下文单元与被遮蔽区域必须执行的安全策略（例如边界检查或授权规则）相关联。 一个单元可能承担多种角色，并且有些单元仍未被归类。 我们从先前的工作中推导出四种候选机制，并将其视为假设。

paragraphs.en: CASE-Bench was built by ten security experts (five Ph.D. and five M.S. students with at least two years of experience in vulnerability analysis) in five steps (Figure 2 ); every manual step was performed independently by two experts.
paragraphs.zh: CASE-Bench 由十位安全专家（五名博士和五名硕士，均拥有至少两年的漏洞分析经验）通过五个步骤构建（图 2）；每个手动步骤均由两名专家独立完成。

paragraphs.en: Selection. We collected reproducible CVEs (e.g., with a public PoC) and prioritized the CWE Top 25 and OWASP Top 10. We excluded fixes that change more than ten files, because they cannot be localized to one coherent region; 488 of 1,236 records passed this screening. Because rebuilding a historical environment takes several person-hours, we selected 236 candidates by two criteria. Reproducibility requires that the base commit builds with an available toolchain and that the PoC replays in an isolated container. Diversity balances weakness types and code bases while limiting near-duplicate CVEs. This purposive sample favours reproducible CVEs, and it used only CVE metadata, never model outputs. We admitted 144 CVEs (145 tasks); most rejections stemmed from build failures of old commits (41), PoCs that did not reproduce (30), or vulnerable code that spanned no coherent region (21).
paragraphs.zh: 筛选。 我们收集了可复现的 CVE（例如带有公开 PoC 的），并优先考虑 CWE Top 25 和 OWASP Top 10。 我们排除了改动超过十个文件的修复，因为它们无法定位到一个连贯区域；1,236 条记录中有 488 条通过了此筛选。 由于重建历史环境需要数个人工小时，我们依据两项标准选出 236 个候选。 可复现性要求基础提交能够用可用工具链完成构建，并且 PoC 能在隔离容器中重放。 多样性则在限制近重复 CVE 的同时平衡漏洞类型和代码库。 这一目的性抽样偏向可复现的 CVE，且仅使用了 CVE 元数据，从未使用模型输出。 我们最终收录了 144 个 CVE（145 个任务）；大多数被拒的原因是旧提交构建失败（41 个）、PoC 无法复现（30 个），或漏洞代码不构成连贯区域（21 个）。

paragraphs.en: Task definition. An expert identified the base commit (the parent of the fix) and the vulnerable region that the fix changes, which becomes the masked region (1 to 1,207 lines, median 10). The expert then wrote a requirement that specifies the intended behaviour (e.g., inputs and intended users) but names no attack or defense. Requirements were drafted with an LLM; two experts audited all of them and rewrote 23. Requirements do not restate policies defined in the visible repository, and the derivability annotation (§ 3.3 ) records whether the security property can be inferred from the available information. In the 51 multi-location tasks, the fix also changes other files, which stay at the vulnerable version.
paragraphs.zh: 任务定义。 专家确定了基础提交（即修复提交的父提交）以及该修复所更改的易受攻击区域，该区域成为被掩蔽区域（1 至 1,207 行，中位数 10 行）。 专家随后撰写一条需求，说明预期行为（例如输入和预期用户），但不点名任何攻击或防御。 需求由大语言模型起草；两位专家审核了全部需求并重写了其中 23 条。 需求不会复述可见仓库中已定义的策略，可推导性标注（§ 3.3）记录安全属性能否从可用信息中推断出来。 在 51 个多位置任务中，修复还更改了其他文件，这些文件仍保持在易受攻击的版本。

paragraphs.en: Information barrier. The model receives the requirement, the target file with a placeholder for the region, and the context, and it returns a unified diff. It never sees vulnerability information (e.g., the CVE identifier or the fix) or our evaluation artifacts (e.g., the tests). Context methods retrieve only from the visible repository , i.e., the base snapshot stripped of the masked region and of any trace of the vulnerability (e.g., the commit history). Because the snapshot precedes the fix, it may contain insecure exemplars (e.g., unfixed siblings with the same weakness). We keep and annotate them, as real repositories contain such code (74 tasks).

paragraphs.en: Each generation is evaluated in a fresh container in three stages. Build: the diff applies, and the project builds and starts (timeout 5 min). Functional tests: all expert-written tests pass (4.6 inputs per task on average; timeout 2 min). The tests cover typical and boundary inputs (e.g., benign inputs along the PoC path), so deny-all code fails them; correctness remains relative to these tests. Exploit: the PoC is replayed (timeout 2 min), and exploitation is decided by an observable effect, e.g., a sanitizer report for memory-safety weaknesses ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Mei et al., 2024 ) or an unauthorized action for web weaknesses, so secure implementations that differ from the historical fix are not penalized ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Each PoC defines its effect check in advance, and Secure requires that the PoC completes without that effect; infrastructure failures trigger re-execution rather than a verdict. For 40 tasks sampled by CWE family, we wrote three exploit variants each (e.g., encoded payloads). For comparison with static evaluation (§ 5.4 ), we also run CWE-specific CodeQL and Joern queries ( GitHub, ; Joern Project, ) and count only alarms whose path crosses the regenerated region.

paragraphs.en: Oracle validation. Table 1 summarizes the validation. An independent reviewer first wrote the alternative implementation (V3) and then reviewed and replayed the task on both versions (V1, V2); 38 tasks needed a second review round, and 9 of them a third. V3 has two purposes. It checks that the oracles do not overfit the historical fix, because the reviewer wrote the alternative before seeing the patch. It also checks solvability within the edit scope, because the alternative replaces only the masked region while all other files stay vulnerable, which matters for multi-location tasks. The two tasks that fail V3 remain solvable within this scope, since the patched region alone passes all checks. V1 shows that the tests do not encode the security property, V4 that deny-all code cannot score as secure, and V6 that the verdicts agree with manual exploitation.

paragraphs.en: Methods. We selected eleven functionality-oriented methods that are published or deployed in widely used tools and that cover all major retrieval families (Table 2 ). We compare their context policies as reproduced in a common pipeline, not the original systems, and name each policy after its source (e.g., CCEval-BM25 for CrossCodeEval). We add two security-aware methods. CodeGuarder ( Lin et al., 2025b ) injects external security knowledge mined from vulnerability databases, rebuilt without the CVEs of CASE-Bench . Source-sink slicing probes repository-internal security context: following data-flow-guided retrieval ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , it retrieves the path from untrusted input to a sensitive operation together with its guards. It uses only the generic CodeQL and Joern models, never the oracle’s queries, and proceeds in five steps. ❶ Anchoring: sources are untrusted values that reach the inputs of the masked region, and sinks are sensitive operations reachable from the code that consumes its result. ❷ Candidates: the analysis collects the paths between them within two call-graph hops, together with their guards, i.e., conditions that decide whether execution reaches the sink. ❸ Request semantics: for web applications, paths link an endpoint to the forms that call it, and guards are recognized by the return values and state that decide whether a request proceeds (e.g., an early exit on a failed permission check), so project-specific wrappers need no hand-written models. ❹ Ordering: shortest paths come first, each as its guards followed by its units in flow order, until the cap. ❺ Failure: without a path, no units are returned, and the prompt equals Local-only. For OpenEMR (§ 5.5 ), step ❸ links the amendment request to its form and retrieves the guard aclCheckCore(’patients’, ’amendment’, …) ; the implementation and all slices are released.

paragraphs.en: Common pipeline. Each method receives the requirement, the masked target file, and the visible repository, and it returns an ordered list of units. We keep each method’s ranking logic and hyperparameters and replace only language-specific parts (e.g., parsers by tree-sitter grammars), so for newly supported languages the policy is inspired by, not validated against, the original. Every prompt contains the task inputs (e.g., the complete masked target file) and a context block, which is empty for Local-only. The units are deduplicated among themselves, serialized in rank order, and truncated at a common retrieval cap of 8K tokens that excludes the target file. The cap equalizes neither length nor cost, so we report actual sizes (Table 2 ) and native budgets. Deduplication does not remove code that repeats the target file, so the in-file methods differ from Local-only: InCoder-FIM re-presents the code around the region next to the generation point, and LongCoder-Mem adds imported declarations, which raises fix-API recall from .12 to .19. Generator-independent contexts are cached and identical across models and runs.
paragraphs.zh: 通用流水线。 每种方法接收需求、被掩码的目标文件以及可见的代码仓库，并返回一个有序的单元列表。 我们保留每种方法的排序逻辑和超参数，仅替换与语言相关的部分（例如，将解析器替换为 tree-sitter 语法），因此对于新支持的语言，该策略是受原方法启发，而非经过原方法验证。 每个提示词都包含任务输入（例如，完整的被掩码目标文件）和一个上下文块，对于 Local-only（仅本地），该上下文块为空。 这些单元在彼此之间去重后，按排名顺序序列化，并在 8K token 的统一检索上限处截断，该上限不包含目标文件。 该上限既不能使长度一致，也不能使成本一致，因此我们报告实际大小（表 2）以及各方法原生的预算。 去重不会移除与目标文件重复的代码，因此文件内方法与 Local-only 不同：InCoder-FIM 重新呈现生成点附近区域的代码，而 LongCoder-Mem 添加导入的声明，这将 fix-API 召回率从 .12 提升至 .19。 与生成器无关的上下文会被缓存，且在不同模型和不同运行之间保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Controls. Six conditions anchor and de-confound the comparison. Local-only shows the masked target file alone and is the reference for all context effects. BM25+README , the configuration of A.S.E ( Lian et al., 2026 ) , anchors our results to a prior evaluation. Repo-128K serializes the visible repository from the target’s directory outward in the format of repository-level benchmarks ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Ding et al., 2023 ) and truncates it so that the complete prompt and an output reserve fit into the smallest window among our models (118K tokens of content on average); as only 6% of projects fit, it is a truncated repository, not the full one. The Reference context contains exactly the annotated safeguards and source-sink path; it is a diagnostic, not an upper bound. The Security reminder and the Placebo add a security instruction or security-themed code from another project, respectively; they bound rather than isolate priming, because foreign code may still convey generic checks.

paragraphs.en: RQ2: context edits and failure patterns. We vary the retrieval cap from 1K to 32K tokens for four methods, and we apply single-element edits to two base contexts, the Reference context and the context of the best functionality-oriented method. Each edit is compared with its unmodified base on all eligible tasks. Remove and Add delete one safeguard role or insert the missing safeguards; because a removed safe API may also carry functional knowledge, we report CbE @1 next to SecPass @1. Insecure inserts one naturally occurring insecure exemplar at a random position (74 tasks), and we never synthesize vulnerable code. Distract appends irrelevant code of 2K to 32K tokens. Two matched controls replace a removed role, or the inserted exemplar, with irrelevant code of the same length at the same position, which separates content from length and position. Finally, Position moves the safeguard within contexts of 4K to 64K tokens, and Rename gives it a neutral name repository-wide.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：上下文编辑与失败模式。 我们将检索上限从 1K 变化到 32K tokens，针对四种方法进行测试，并对两个基础上下文应用单元素编辑：参考（Reference）上下文和最佳面向功能性方法的上下文。 每次编辑都会在所有符合条件的任务上与其未修改的基础上下文进行比较。 删除（Remove）与添加（Add）操作分别删除一个安全防护角色或插入缺失的安全防护；由于被删除的安全 API 也可能承载功能性知识，我们会在 SecPass @1 旁报告 CbE @1。 不安全（Insecure）在随机位置插入一个自然出现的不安全示例（74 个任务），我们从不合成易受攻击的代码。 干扰（Distract）追加 2K 到 32K tokens 的无关代码。 两个匹配对照在被删除角色的位置或被插入示例的位置替换为相同长度的无关代码，从而将内容与长度和位置的影响区分开来。 最后，位置（Position）在 4K 到 64K tokens 的上下文中移动安全防护的位置，重命名（Rename）则在全仓库范围内给它一个中性名称。

paragraphs.en: To explain why code remains insecure, each correct-but-exploitable generation receives one or more of five failure labels (Table 5 ); for example, Unused means that a safeguard is present but neither called nor replicated, and Imitated requires an AST similarity of at least 0.7 to an exemplar in the context. Equivalent checks are detected with the guard analyses of CodeQL and Joern ( GitHub, ; Joern Project, ) . Two authors labeled a stratified sample of 200 generations manually, and we also compare the dominant labels of two methods within each task-model pair, which avoids changes in the denominator. The labels describe co-occurrence, not cause.

paragraphs.en: RQ3: agents. We run SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) with two backbones and Claude Code, three runs per task, in an isolated sandbox (e.g., without network access). Agents may explore and run the whole repository but edit only the masked region (at most 50 steps and USD 2 per task). This restriction keeps the task one of secure generation , since edits elsewhere would turn it into repository-wide repair, and it keeps agents comparable with retrieval-based methods. The observed context of a trajectory is every region that a tool returned to the agent after output truncation. Observed tokens accumulate over the trajectory, so they do not measure a single prompt, and we do not track whether a region remains in the agent’s context at its final edit. For each trajectory, we record whether the safeguard was observed before the first edit of the masked region and whether the run hit the step or cost cap. Search queries are classified automatically as functional or security-related; identifiers (e.g., wrapper names) count as functional unless they contain a security term, and two authors validated this classification on 300 queries.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：智能体。 我们使用两个骨干模型运行 SWE-agent（Yang et al., 2024）以及 Claude Code，每个任务运行三次，均在隔离沙箱中（例如，没有网络访问）。 智能体可以探索并运行整个代码仓库，但只能编辑被遮蔽的区域（每个任务最多 50 步和 2 美元）。 这一限制使任务保持在安全生成范畴，因为在其他位置的编辑会将其转变为仓库级修复，同时也使智能体与基于检索的方法具有可比性。 轨迹的观测上下文是输出截断后工具返回给智能体的每个区域。 观测到的 token 在整个轨迹中累积，因此它们并非衡量单个提示，而且我们也不追踪某个区域在智能体最终编辑时是否仍保留在其上下文中。 对于每条轨迹，我们记录在首次编辑被遮蔽区域之前是否观测到防护机制，以及该次运行是否触及步数或成本上限。 搜索查询被自动分类为功能性或安全相关；标识符（例如包装器名称）除非包含安全术语，否则计为功能性，并且两位作者对 300 条查询验证了这一分类。

paragraphs.en: Because tasks are clustered within projects ( Arcuri and Briand, 2011 ) , we report 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals over the 51 projects ( Efron and Tibshirani, 1994 ) and test with logistic mixed-effects models ( Bates et al., 2015 ) with random intercepts for project, task, and task-model pair. We test 18 pre-specified comparisons with Holm correction ( Holm, 1979 ) : each of the 13 methods against Local-only, the two security-aware methods against both priming controls, and the Reference context against the best functionality-oriented method. We regard differences of at least 3 pp as practically relevant, a threshold fixed before the analysis. The best method is selected on the same data, which makes the Reference-versus-best difference conservative. A power analysis on a pilot run showed 80% power for 5.6 pp after correction, so a nonsignificant result does not establish the absence of an effect. We compare rankings with Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} ( Kendall, 1938 ) and report Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) for manual annotations. All other analyses (e.g., robustness checks and agent analyses) are exploratory and reported as estimates; runs that fail for infrastructure reasons are re-executed, and outputs are never resampled based on their content.

paragraphs.en: Correctness-optimal is not security-optimal. ProCC-Multi has the highest FuncPass @1 (65.1%) but ranks only third in SecPass @1, because correct-but-exploitable code accounts for 72% of its functional gain. CCEval-BM25 and Repo-128K even raise CbE @1 by more than FuncPass @1, so their additional working code is exploitable on balance. The rankings by FuncPass @1 and SecPass @1 agree only moderately ( τ b = 0.48 \tau_{b}=0.48 ), and a cross-fitted oracle that picks the best method per task exceeds the best single method by 3.3 pp, so the methods are complementary.

paragraphs.en: Security-aware context helps, depending on the weakness. CodeGuarder adds 4.2 pp (OR 1.40, p Holm = .07 p_{\text{Holm}}=.07 ) and Source-sink 5.5 pp (OR 1.53, p Holm = .006 p_{\text{Holm}}=.006 ), and both lower CbE @1 below Local-only. Their advantages over the priming controls are not significant after correction, but the Placebo changes SecPass @1 by only 0.3 pp, and the Security reminder adds 1.3 pp while lowering FuncPass @1 by 1.8 pp because some generations reject benign inputs. The Reference context adds 12.2 pp, 8.5 pp more than the best functionality-oriented method (OR 1.69, p Holm = .001 p_{\text{Holm}}=.001 ), and Source-sink recovers 4% of the Local-only-to-Reference gain. By CWE family (Table 4 ), CodeGuarder is strongest on memory safety, where generic checks transfer, whereas Source-sink is strongest on access control (9.3% vs. 3.1%), where security depends on project policies. These are method-level comparisons, since the two methods also differ in retrieval logic and context length. By locality, the best functionality-oriented method gains +2.0, +6.4, and +0.8 pp on L1 to L3 tasks, whereas Source-sink gains +1.8, +6.8, and +7.4 pp and the Reference context +3.8, +14.8, and +17.0 pp. Similarity retrieval thus occasionally surfaces a project API (L2) but almost never a project policy (L3). paragraphs.en: Failure patterns. With functionality-oriented context, most correct-but-exploitable code lacks a safeguard ( Missing ) or imitates an exemplar ( Imitated ); with security-aware context, unused and misused safeguards become frequent (Table 5 ). The shift holds per 100 generations, so it is not an artifact of the denominator: Missing falls from 20.6 to 12.3, while Unused and Misused together rise from 10.7 to 21.3. It also appears within task-model pairs, where the dominant label moves from Missing to a utilization failure in 29% of pairs and in the reverse direction in 5%. Label precision ranges from .72 ( Imitated ) to .94 ( Missing ). In multi-location tasks, 14% of correct-but-exploitable generations guard the masked region locally but consume an unchecked value from an unfixed sibling, and open coding revealed two further patterns (e.g., defending against the wrong attack).

paragraphs.en: Exploration. Agents raise FuncPass @1 over the best retrieval-based method with the same backbone by 2.7-7.1 pp but change SecPass @1 by only − 1.3 -1.3 to + 0.5 +0.5 pp (Table 6 ), consistent with prior agent studies ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Patir et al., 2025 ) . Although agents observe 16-26 × \times as many repository tokens as an 8K context, they observe the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of trajectories, yet an insecure exemplar in 43-51% of the trajectories on tasks that contain one. paragraphs.en: Observation and outcome. Trajectories that observed and used the safeguard reach 34.5% SecPass @1, versus 12.7% for those that never observed it (Figure 7 b). paragraphs.en: Static analysis and the PoC oracle disagree on 36.8% of the 28,984 functionally correct RQ1 generations ( κ = 0.25 \kappa=0.25 ; Table 7 ), and the disagreement goes in both directions. Relative to the PoC verdict, static analysis has a precision of .87 and a recall of .60: it misses 40% of exploited generations (e.g., off-by-one bounds checks), and it flags 27% of the generations that resist the PoC, which may be false alarms or vulnerabilities that the PoC does not trigger. The same pattern appears on code with known verdicts: the queries miss 17% of the vulnerable versions and flag 13% of the patched ones. Exploit variants compromise 7.3% of the generations that resist the base PoC. On the same 145 tasks, the two oracles rank the methods only moderately alike ( τ b = 0.56 \tau_{b}=0.56 ; Figure 8 ): static analysis favours ProCC-Multi and CodeGuarder, whereas the PoC oracle favours ClaudeCode-Ret and Source-sink. Comparative conclusions about context methods therefore depend on the oracle, and a static-only evaluation would have favoured methods whose code merely contains defensive patterns.

paragraphs.en: We examine CVE-2022-2732 in OpenEMR (CWE-862, L3), the access-control task on which the conditions differ most (18 generations each). Before the fix, any authenticated user could amend a patient record through add_edit_amendments.php . The required permission appears only in a widget guard in demographics.php (Figure 9 ) and cannot be inferred from the requirement, while the target file and its sibling pages contain misleading or missing checks. Local-only produced no secure generation, and functionality-oriented methods produced at most three, because similarity retrieval favoured the unchecked siblings ( Imitated ). Following CodeGuarder’s generic advice, generations checked only for a login, which the PoC user has, or demanded administrator rights, which rejects the legitimate clinician of the functional tests (1/18). ClaudeCode-Ret retrieved demographics.php but ranked it after the siblings (3/18), whereas Source-sink followed the request from its form to the database write and retrieved the guard (6/18). The Reference context yielded 12 secure generations, but four generations checked the permission only after the request had been processed ( Misused ). Retrieving the policy thus did not ensure its correct use on the attack path. Together with the motivating example, in which similarity retrieval exposed a guard, the case shows that the same method can help on one task and hurt on another, depending on whether similar code carries the safeguard.

paragraphs.en: Why functionality-oriented retrieval misses safeguards. Our results suggest a common cause. Functionality-oriented methods build their queries from the target code and the requirement, which describe what the code does rather than which policy constrains it. Safeguards, however, often live elsewhere in the repository (e.g., in a central access-control module), so they rarely resemble the target, whereas unfixed siblings resemble it closely. Agents show the same bias in their search queries (Finding 4), and longer contexts mainly add more siblings (§ 5.2 ). The motivating example illustrates the exception: similarity helps only when a sibling happens to carry the guard, which makes functionality-oriented retrieval an unreliable source of safeguards.

paragraphs.en: Future directions. Two directions follow from our results. paragraphs.en: Security of LLM-generated code. Code assistants often suggest vulnerable code ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Perry et al., 2023 ) . Secure-code benchmarks have progressed from snippets with static or manual judgment ( Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ; Tony et al., 2023 ; Bhatt et al., 2023 ; Hajipour et al., 2024 ; Siddiq et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) to executable function-level and application-level tasks ( Peng et al., 2025 ; Nie et al., 2025 ; Vero et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Patir et al., 2025 ) , and then to repository-level tasks from real vulnerabilities ( Lian et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) (Table 8 ). A.S.E ( Lian et al., 2026 ) judges security with static rules. SecRepoBench ( Shen et al., 2026 ) and RealSec-bench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) find that agents and retrievers mainly improve correctness. Table 8 compares CASE-Bench with these benchmarks along the capabilities that a study of context requires. Executable functional and exploit oracles are increasingly common, and several benchmarks also evaluate agents. CASE-Bench differs from all of them in treating the context as the controlled variable and in annotating security-relevant code, which makes the content of a context measurable. Security-agent benchmarks ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Mei et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) and vulnerability repair ( Bui et al., 2022 ; Fu et al., 2022 ; Pearce et al., 2023 ) start from a known vulnerability, whereas our models are never told that one exists. We share their emphasis on executable, effect-based verdicts, and like SEC-bench Pro ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , we find that the grading rule can change conclusions. Our validation and contamination checks follow SWE-bench Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) and studies of evaluation leakage ( Matton et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 生成代码的安全性。 代码助手经常会建议有漏洞的代码（Pearce et al., 2022；Perry et al., 2023）。 安全代码基准已从采用静态或人工判定的代码片段（Siddiq and Santos, 2022；Tony et al., 2023；Bhatt et al., 2023；Hajipour et al., 2024；Siddiq et al., 2024；Li et al., 2025），发展到可执行的函数级与应用级任务（Peng et al., 2025；Nie et al., 2025；Vero et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026b；Patir et al., 2025），再到基于真实漏洞的仓库级任务（Lian et al., 2026；Shen et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026a；Zhao et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026b）（表 8）。 A.S.E（Lian et al., 2026）使用静态规则来判定安全性。 SecRepoBench（Shen et al., 2026）和 RealSec-bench（Wang et al., 2026b）发现，智能体和检索器主要提升的是正确性。 表 8 沿着上下文研究所需的各项能力，将 CASE-Bench 与这些基准进行比较。 可执行的函数级与漏洞利用判定标准日益常见，若干基准还评估智能体。 CASE-Bench 与上述所有基准的不同之处在于，它将上下文视为受控变量，并对与安全相关的代码进行标注，从而使上下文的内容可以被度量。 安全智能体基准（Lee et al., 2025；Lee et al., 2026；Mei et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2026c；Zhu et al., 2025）和漏洞修复（Bui et al., 2022；Fu et al., 2022；Pearce et al., 2023）都从已知漏洞出发，而我们的模型从不被告知存在漏洞。 我们与它们一样强调基于可执行、基于效果的判定，并且与 SEC-bench Pro（Lee et al., 2026）一样，我们发现评分规则可能改变结论。 我们的验证与污染检查遵循 SWE-bench Verified（OpenAI, 2024）以及关于评测数据泄漏的研究（Matton et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Improving the security of generated code. Model-side techniques (e.g., security hardening ( He and Vechev, 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ) or constrained decoding ( Fu et al., 2024 ) ) and prompting ( Tony et al., 2025 ) change the model or the instruction. Retrieval-based approaches add external security knowledge ( Zhang et al., 2024a ; Lin et al., 2025b ; Shi and Zhang, 2026 ) or show that poisoned corpora induce vulnerable code ( Lin et al., 2025a ) . We instead study the context that the repository itself provides, which is benign but can still mislead, and we include CodeGuarder as a representative of external knowledge.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we constructed CASE-Bench , an executable and annotated benchmark for studying how repository context affects the security of LLM-generated code. Using CASE-Bench , we conducted a controlled study of 13 context construction methods with six LLMs, together with single-element context edits and an analysis of coding-agent trajectories. We revealed that functionality-oriented context improves correctness more than security, that withheld safeguards and inserted insecure exemplars reduce security, and that coding agents rarely search for security-relevant code. Based on these findings, we provided guidelines for retrieving project safeguards and checking retrieved examples. We believe that our work lays the groundwork for security-aware context construction in LLM coding assistants.
